name: VEYRA
description: VEYRA - Electric, inside out. Interactive EV configurator: a hero vehicle stage, hover-swapped feature videos, appearance swatches for paint and wheels, and technical callouts.

palette.accents: product swatches only - sky-blue, lime-green, electric-green, graphite

typography.display: tight modern grotesk, oversized lowercase headlines

layout: hero with model name + one-line tagline
appearance menu: paint and wheel swatches
spec/tech callout markers over the product
motion: hover-triggered video swap, forward and reverse
live re-render when a colour/wheel swatch is picked
voice: reductive product marketing - short spec-led lines, lead with the tagline 'Electric, inside out.'
